  Francine Kerridge, Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:00 PM, Chair Parkin called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bender, Brown, Orozco, Soto, Tushnet, Parkin

Commissioners Absent: Okatch

Also present: Francine Kerridge, Director, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, Ashleigh Stone,
Deputy City Attorney, Karen Baldwin, City Clerk Analyst.

Chair Parkin spoke; and announced that Commissioner Okatch was excused from the meeting.

ELECTION OF CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR

A motion was made by Vice Chair Tushnet, to elect Chair Parkin for Chair of the Police
Oversight Commission. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Bender, Brown, Orozco, Tushnet, Parkin
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  2  Okatch, Soto

A motion was made by Chair Parkin, to elect Vice Chair Tushnet for Vice Chair of the Police
Oversight Commission. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Bender, Brown, Orozco, Tushnet, Parkin
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  2  Okatch, Soto

Chair Parkin declared the nominations open for Chair.

Chair Parkin accepted the Chair of the Police Oversight Commission nomination.

Chair Parkin declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

Chair Parkin nominated Vice Chair Tushnet as Vice Chair of the Police Oversight Commission.
